description: This file defines a Swift enum `SignificantLocationMonitor` that handles monitoring significant location changes via CoreLocation and reporting updates to a gateway. It contains a method to start monitoring if certain conditions are met and sends location updates as JSON payloads.

methods.name: startIfNeeded
methods.description: Starts monitoring significant location changes if the location mode is set to always and authorization is granted, then encodes and sends location updates to a gateway.
